title: Kiss: Psycho Circus - The Nightmare Child/Automatic-Use Items
text:
All these items are used upon being picked up.

 Elemental Icons provide you with ammo for your weapons. You get +10 for and Icon, +40 for a Cube and +100 for a Tablet.
 Health Potions increase your current health. You gain +10 for a Vial, +30 for a Flask and +60 for a Bottle.
 Blood Rose gives you 100 health to a maximum of 250. If you don't have an Elder Plate, try to get as many health as possible with Health Potions before picking up a Blood Rose.
 Angel Charm makes you invulnerable. Difficult to obtain, but the effect lasts long enough to survive even the hardest of the battles. You can survive even falling into a bottomless pit, but you will die as soon as the effect wears off, so bottomless pits are still fatal even with this artifact.
